_comment: Breadcrumb the :run skill writes as it fetches, so manifest.json records real provenance and a required source that came back empty aborts the run instead of producing a confident empty report.

sources.name: calls listed (transcript source)
sources.tool: mixed: gong list_calls, fireflies_get_transcripts, local directory scan
sources.diagnosis: No calls came back for the window. Either the connected identity can only see its own calls (common with a personal Gong or Fireflies token — a manager needs workspace or team scope), the recordings live in a workspace the token cannot read, or the window predates retention.

sources.name: transcripts fetched
sources.tool: mixed: gong retrieve_transcripts, fireflies_get_transcript, file read
sources.query: one fetch per call_id in the index
sources.diagnosis: Calls were listed but no transcript bodies came back. Most often the recordings exist without transcription enabled, or the API scope covers call metadata but not transcript content.

sources.name: framework scoring pass
sources.query: MEDDPICC, 8 dimensions, evidence required for met/partial
sources.diagnosis: Transcripts normalized but nothing was scored — the scoring step did not run or wrote a malformed scored_calls.json.

sources.name: crm deals (optional linkage)
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, Amount, StageName, IsClosed, IsWon, CloseDate, Original_Close_Date__c, Close_Date_Push_Count__c, Owner.Name, Account.Name FROM Opportunity WHERE Id IN (...)
sources.diagnosis: Optional. Without it the report still scores every call; it just cannot show which framework gaps precede the deals that slip or lose.

warnings: call-1047: the export could not separate two attendees dialling in from one room.
